# Guildy

> Free AI interview prep built from the real job description, your resume, and the exact round you are interviewing for. Paste a job and your resume and get Quick Prep in about 20 seconds, no signup. Guildy is also the command center for the whole job hunt: track every application and every round in one pipeline, and go deeper with Deep Prep when a round matters.

## Product

- Quick Prep: free, no signup. Reads the role and the round, then returns what the interview tests, how to position yourself, and the questions to expect.
- Deep Prep: paid ($19.99/mo). Round-by-round question sets, model answers in your voice, interviewer and company insight, and a reusable story bank.
- Pipeline: track applications across Screen, Hiring Manager, and Full Loop rounds in one place.
